plugins.name: claude-code-internals
plugins.description: Gives Claude source-level knowledge of its own architecture. 166 lessons covering every internal subsystem — hooks (all 31 event types, including DirectoryAdded, plus PreToolUse-bypasses-canUseTool and the hook input contract), permissions (7-phase pipeline, 23 validators), boot sequence, agents, compaction, MCP, memory, sessions, plugins, AskUserQuestion — binary-verified through the v2.1.231 CLI + Claude Desktop app.asar 1.30096.1 + the Desktop-managed host agent 2.1.229 + the in-VM Cowork agent ELF + the golden Cowork VM disk image + live fcache decodes. Recent chapters cover self-hosted runners (customer machines as Claude's compute), the dark device bridge that serves shell and file tools to claude.ai over a WebSocket, the auto-memory allow carve-out in the host-loop canUseTool chain, Artifacts comments, directory sync and cross-session messaging, skill/plugin discovery, elicitation routing, and Cowork internals (host-loop vs VM-loop, spawn flags, the stream-json control protocol, sandbox mounts, execution lanes, GrowthBook gates) — plus a mutable current-state layer over the append-only lesson chapters. Searchable via RRF (keyword + TF-IDF fusion).
